from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, textwrap
task=Path("reports/T0007")
freeze=json.loads((task/"review-r1-freeze/audit.json").read_text())
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
docs=["README.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","reports/T0007/review-r1/review.md"]
for p,h in freeze["input_sha256"].items():
    if p not in docs:assert sha(p)==h,p
for p,h in freeze["history_sha256"].items():assert sha(p)==h,p
links=blocks=0
for name in docs:
    p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n") and all(line==line.rstrip() for line in s.splitlines()),name
    assert "needs_changes" in s,name
    for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        target=target.strip("<>").split("#",1)[0]
        if target and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z]+:",target):
            assert (p.parent/target).exists(),(name,target)
            links+=1
    for i,code in enumerate(re.findall(chr(96)*3+r"python\n(.*?)"+chr(96)*3,s,re.S)):
        compile(textwrap.dedent(code),f"{name}:{i}","exec")
        blocks+=1
check=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert check.returncode==0,check.stdout+check.stderr
handoff=Path(docs[2]).read_text()
for i in (1,2,3,4,6):assert f"- [x] A{i}：" in handoff
for i in (5,7):assert f"- [ ] A{i}：" in handoff
runs={}
for name in ("review-r1-freeze","review-r1-full","review-r1-probes"):
    d=task/name;rec=json.loads((d/"record.json").read_text())
    assert rec["status"]=="finished" and rec["exit_code"]==0,name
    assert rec["before"]["source_sha256"]==rec["after"]["source_sha256"],name
    for stream in ("stdout","stderr"):assert sha(d/(stream+".txt"))==rec[stream+"_sha256"]
    runs[name]={k:rec[k] for k in ("argv","exit_code","elapsed_s","started_at_utc","finished_at_utc")}
assert "482 passed in 4.30s" in (task/"review-r1-full/stdout.txt").read_text()
assert not (task/"review-r1-full/stderr.txt").read_bytes()
artifacts=docs+["reports/T0007/review-r1/probe.py","reports/T0007/review-r1-probes/findings.json","reports/T0007/review-r1-freeze/audit.json"]
audit={
"created_at_utc":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
"result":"NEEDS_CHANGES","task_status":"needs_changes","head":freeze["head"],"branch":freeze["branch"],
"reviewer":"Codex + gpt-6-astra xhigh","independent_static_reviewer":"/root/review_t0006_tests",
"reviewed_files":{p:sha(p) for p in ("src/kmesh/logic/dependency.py","tests/test_dependency.py")},
"product_defect_found":False,
"acceptance":{"A1":"PASS","A2":"PASS","A3":"PASS","A4":"PASS","A5":"needs_changes_R1","A6":"PASS","A7":"needs_changes_R2"},
"findings":[
{"id":"R1","priority":"P2","file":"tests/test_dependency.py","line":276,"summary":"Generator rejection test misses required complete reason/type; a wrong diagnostic passes.","minimal_change":"Add must be a tuple of Clause and got generator assertions; preserve not-consumed check."},
{"id":"R2","priority":"P2","file":"reports/T0007/pi-r1-full/provenance.md","line":6,"summary":"Torch version and GPU fluctuation explanation contradict archived version and CUDA hiding; command/basetemp deviations and evidence limits omitted.","minimal_change":"Append accurate corrections and clarify unarchived doctor repeats / RUN rename; do not modify old evidence or recreate history."}],
"verification_runs":runs,"full_regression":"482 passed in 4.30s; no skip/xfail; stderr empty",
"probe_results":json.loads((task/"review-r1-probes/findings.json").read_text()),
"pi_records_hash_verified":len(freeze["pi_records"]),"historical_files_preserved":len(freeze["history_sha256"]),
"closure_checks":{"git_diff_check":"PASS","local_links_checked":links,"python_blocks_compiled":blocks,"text_hygiene":"PASS"},
"artifact_sha256":{p:sha(p) for p in artifacts},
"next_round_scope":"Frozen product; two assertions plus optional inaccurate comment removal; new focused run with basetemp and doc hygiene only, inherit this full regression when original sources/tests unchanged.",
"limits":["No product/test edit by Codex","Three later doctor successes and original failed RUN name unverified pending clarification","No commit/push","No scientific conclusion or complete world-audit claim"]
}
with (task/"review-r1/final-audit.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(audit,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write("\n")
print(f"PASS: frozen product/tests and {len(freeze['history_sha256'])} historical files unchanged")
print(f"PASS: diff, {links} local links, {blocks} Python blocks, task needs_changes")
print("PASS: final-audit.json written; only R1 test assertions and R2 record corrections remain")
